review_candidates.title: Sr. Systems Administrator
review_candidates.description: Impact Starts at  UNICEF Canada JOIN OUR TEAM AS SENIOR SYSTEMS ADMINISTRATOR Are you a hands-on technologist who wants to own it all, from fixing a laptop at someone's desk to hunting threats across a modern cloud security stack? Join UNICEF Canada - one of Canada's most respected and historic charities - is looking for a Senior Systems Administrator to play a key role in managing, securing and evolving our technology environment. This is a dynamic, hands-on position where you'll take ownership of the full spectrum of IT operations, including day-to-day help desk and desk-side support, Microsoft 365, cloud services, servers, networks and cybersecurity. You'll be directly involved in supporting staff with their everyday technology needs while also tackling complex technical challenges, strengthening our cybersecurity posture and driving improvements across our IT environment. Your work will help keep our staff, volunteers and partners connected, secure and productive in support of children around the world. Position Details   Position Title    Senior Systems Administrator   Employment     Type:    Permanent, Full-time     Reports to:    Deputy Director, IT      Direct         Reports:    0   Salary Range:    $70,500 to $85,500 per year with benefits and 3     weeks paid vacation    Work       Location:   Toronto    Work       Environment:    UNICEF Canada currently operates under a Fixed-       Hybrid model that requires team members to attend t he    office at least 2 days/week (Tuesday & Wednesday).   Why UNICEF & UNICEF Canada? UNICEF  is the world’s farthest-reaching humanitarian organization for children . Across 190 countries and territories, and in the world’s toughest places, we provide and advocate for education, health and nutrition services. We protect children from violence and abuse. Bring clean water and sanitation to those in need. Keep them safe from climate change and disease. Serve as the world’s largest provider of vaccines. Before, during and after emergencies, we’re on the ground with life-saving help and hope. The needs of children around the world continue to increase and the role of UNICEF is more important than ever. UNICEF Canada  is one of 32 National Committees located in high-income countries around the world . Our team exists to fundraise for UNICEF’s highest priorities, and to work neutrally with governments and the private sector in Canada and internationally to advance the rights and well-being of children and youth.    As UNICEF Canada launches a bold new Strategic Plan in 2026 ,  be part of this next phase of impact! The Opportunity This is a hands-on, end-to-end IT role. UNICEF Canada does not have a separate help desk or Tier 1 function, so the Senior Systems Administrator is responsible for all levels of technical support. The role also leads day-to-day security operations, including hardening our Microsoft 365 environment, managing endpoint protection, and responding to alerts from our managed detection and response provider. On any given day you might: Get a new staff member's laptop, accounts and MFA set up and walk them through it in person Troubleshoot a Teams, printer or VPN issue at someone's desk or over a remote session Triage a security alert from our MDR provider and contain a compromised account Tighten a Conditional Access policy or roll out an Intune configuration Patch servers, check backups and plan a firewall change Cybersecurity is the center of gravity of the role. UNICEF Canada handles donor and payment data, and we're a target for phishing, business email compromise and fraud. You'll run the day-to-day security operations that protect that trust, working closely with the Deputy Director, IT, and our security partners. Key Accountabilities   Cybersecurity operations and compliance (35%) Run day-to-day security operations across our stack: Sophos endpoint protection (EDR), Field Effect Covalence managed detection and response (MDR), Barracuda email security, Microsoft Defender and Password management. Act as the first internal responder to alerts from Field Effect, Sophos and Defender: triage, investigate, contain and remediate, escalating to the Deputy Director, IT as needed. Own identity security in Microsoft Entra ID: MFA, Conditional Access, privileged access, sign-in risk policies and regular access reviews. Configure and maintain Microsoft security and compliance tools, including Defender for Office 365, Purview DLP, sensitivity labels, retention and audit. Track and improve our Microsoft Secure Score and endpoint compliance, and drive vulnerability and patch management to agreed timelines. Maintain incident response, ransomware and business continuity playbooks, and take part in tabletop exercises and full restore tests. Run our security awareness program, including KeepNet phishing simulations, targeted training and follow-up with staff. Support audits, external assessments and alignment with NIST CSF 2.0, privacy law (PIPEDA, Quebec Law 25), and payment security requirements (PCI DSS). Review new vendors, apps and AI tools for security and privacy risk before they're adopted. End-user and desk-side support (25%) Provide all tiers of technical support (Tier 1 through 3) to staff and volunteers, in person, by phone, Teams and remote session. Own the IT ticket queue end to end: logging, prioritizing, resolving and closing requests, and spotting recurring issues to fix at the root. Manage the device lifecycle for laptops, mobile devices, printers and peripherals: procurement, imaging or Autopilot enrolment, deployment, repair and secure disposal. Run onboarding and offboarding: accounts, licenses, devices, access and secure removal of access on departure. Support executives and leadership with responsive, discreet, and white-glove service. Set up and support meeting rooms, AV and Teams Rooms for in-office and hybrid meetings. Write clear how-to guides and train staff on Microsoft 365 and other core tools. Microsoft 365 and cloud administration (20%) Administer Microsoft 365: Exchange Online, Teams, SharePoint, OneDrive and Power Platform. Manage devices and apps through Microsoft Intune, including compliance policies, configuration profiles, and app deployment. Administer Microsoft Entra ID, including hybrid identity with on-premises Active Directory where it remains. Manage Azure resources and cloud services, keeping cost, security and performance in check. Support the integration and security of business platforms, including Salesforce Nonprofit Cloud, Raiser's Edge NXT and our fundraising and payment platforms. Use scripting and automation (PowerShell, Graph API, Power Automate) to cut manual work and improve consistency. Stay current on Microsoft 365 updates and roll out new features thoughtfully. Infrastructure, network and backup (20%) Manage our network: firewalls, switches, Wi-Fi and VPN at head office and regional sites. Maintain remaining on-premises and virtual servers (Windows Server, Hyper-V), including patching, monitoring and capacity planning. Manage backup and recovery for Microsoft 365, cloud and on-premises systems, and test restores regularly. Manage telephony and collaboration infrastructure, including Teams Phone and VoIP. Document systems, configurations, network diagrams and procedures, and keep them current. Lead or support IT infrastructure projects and perform off-hours maintenance when needed to minimize disruption. Qualifications Education: A two-year post-secondary diploma or degree in IT or a related field, or equivalent experience. Experience: 5+ years in IT, with at least 3 years as a systems administrator in a generalist role that included hands-on end-user support. Cybersecurity: Hands-on experience with EDR/XDR and responding to security incidents, plus a working knowledge of phishing, BEC, ransomware and account-compromise response. Microsoft 365 and Entra ID: 3+ years administering Microsoft 365, including Exchange Online, Defender, Conditional Access, MFA and Intune. End-user support: A strong service mindset and proven experience supporting staff at every level, including executives, in person and remotely. Networking: Solid knowledge of TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, VPN, VLANs, Wi-Fi and firewall configuration. Servers and backup: Experience with Windows Server, Active Directory and Group Policy, Hyper-V, and backup and recovery tools. Scripting: Comfort with PowerShell, or the drive to build it quickly. Communication: The ability to explain technical and security risks in plain language to non-technical staff and leaders. Ownership: You work well independently, manage competing priorities, and follow through from ticket to project. Flexibility: Willingness to travel occasionally within Canada and do off-hours maintenance or incident response when required. An Employer of Choice: What We Offer UNICEF Canada is where diverse talent & passion come together to create extraordinary impact for every child. We are committed to being an employer of choice and building a culture that is inclusive, ambitious, compassionate, and high impact.  Members of the UNICEF Canada team have access to the following employee benefits:   A ROBUST COMPENSATION PACKAGE Extended Health/Dental benefits, Healthcare Spending Account, and Wellness Account Life, AD&D, & Long-Term disability insurance coverage Employer match contributions (5%) to a Group Pension Plan Access to parental leave top-up A COMMITMENT TO WELLNESS Fixed hybrid work environment to balance connection and collaboration with the work-life integration needs of our team Minimum 3 weeks of annual vacation (increases with time served) & 1 additional day per year of service (max 30) 10 paid sick days & 2 personal days 8 employee wellness days – an additional series of pre-set days off, given annually to further extend long weekends Discounted rate for a GoodLife gym membership Access to an Employee and Family Assistance Program A CULTURE OF LEARNING & GROWTH Access to a comprehensive global learning platform with over 1600 courses, webinars & resources Internal leadership development, training, & mentorship programs that integrate Anti-Racism and diversity, equity and inclusion principles Opportunities to access both local & global stretch assignments AN INCLUSIVE & PURPOSE-DRIVEN WORKPLACE Centrally located head office in mid-town Toronto with satellite offices in Montreal Easily accessed by public transit and a short walk from several parking locations Inclusive & accessible co-working and meeting spaces designed to foster purpose at every turn and accommodate the diverse needs of employees A CHANCE TO DO MEANINGFUL & LIFE-CHANGING WORK Under the leadership of a dynamic, accomplished, and experienced executive leadership team, you’ll be part of a diverse & talented Canada team committed to creating meaningful impact while fostering an inclusive and supportive work environment. You’ll join a global UNICEF family with a shared commitment to impact the lives of children   Our Commitment to Inclusive Workplaces & Recruitment UNICEF Canada is an inclusive workplace and is committed to championing diversity, equity, inclusion and accessibility. Requests for accommodation can be made at any stage of the recruitment process. At UNICEF Canada, we believe strongly in personal connections and our hiring process is entirely human-driven. We do not use AI or automated systems to review applications or conduct interviews. Each candidate is evaluated by our experienced team to ensure a fair and thoughtful hiring experience. How to Apply Please submit your resume and cover letter as one document to careers@unicef.ca by 11:59PM EST on November 26, 2027. Please reference  "Senior Systems Administrator"  in the subject heading.  UNICEF Canada thanks all applicants for their interest in this opportunity, however, only those selected for an interview will be contacted. Consistent with our Child Safeguarding Policy, all successful candidates must receive clearance by a police background check (including a vulnerable sector screen).

review_candidates.title: Systems Administrator
review_candidates.description: Description About Us Inform Diagnostics, a Fulgent Genetics Company , is a nationally recognized diagnostics laboratory focused on anatomic pathology subspecialties including gastrointestinal pathology, dermatopathology, urologic pathology, hematopathology, and breast pathology. Founded in 2011, our parent entity, Fulgent Genetics, has evolved into a premier, full-service genomic testing company built around a foundational technology platform. Through our diverse testing menu, Fulgent is focused on transforming patient care in oncology, anatomic pathology, infectious and rare diseases, and reproductive health. We believe that by providing a wide range of effective, flexible testing options in conjunction with best-in-class service and support, we can redefine the way medicine is managed for patients and clinicians alike. Since integrating with our therapeutic development business, Fulgent is also developing drug candidates for treating a broad range of cancers using a novel nanoencapsulation and targeted therapy platform. By merging our fields of expertise, we aim to become a fully integrated precision medicine company. Summary Of Position The Systems Administrator is responsible for the day-to-day administration, maintenance, security, and support of the company’s server, identity, and endpoint infrastructure. This is a Microsoft-centric role built around Windows Server, Microsoft Entra ID, Microsoft 365, and Microsoft Intune, with supporting responsibility for Linux systems and public cloud resources in Azure and AWS. Because we operate multiple business entities, the role requires comfort working across distinct domains, directories, and tenants, and in a regulated environment where systems store and transmit protected health information. This position is based in Coppell, Texas on a hybrid schedule. Key Job Elements Administer, patch, and maintain Windows Server 2019/2022/2025 systems across physical, virtual, and cloud-hosted environments. Manage Hyper-V hosts and failover clusters, including guest provisioning, capacity planning, and host maintenance windows. Administer Active Directory Domain Services and core network services including DNS, DHCP, Group Policy, and certificate services. Manage Microsoft Entra ID (formerly Azure AD), including hybrid identity via Entra Connect, conditional access policies, MFA enforcement, and SSO/SAML application integrations. Administer Microsoft 365, including Exchange Online, SharePoint Online, OneDrive for Business, and Microsoft Teams, covering mail flow, sharing controls, and license assignment. Manage the Windows endpoint fleet through Microsoft Intune and Microsoft Configuration Manager (SCCM), including enrollment, compliance policies, application deployment, and Autopilot provisioning. Execute user lifecycle operations – onboarding, role changes, transfers, and offboarding – and support periodic access reviews. Administer monitoring for overall systems performance to proactively identify potential issues, and drive incidents to resolution. Implement updates and patching for all systems and remediate system vulnerabilities within defined service levels. Assist in administration and maintenance of backup systems and other backup storage technologies, and perform periodic restore testing against defined recovery objectives. Administer Azure infrastructure resources including virtual machines, virtual networks, and storage accounts, and support AWS resources (EC2, S3, IAM) in coordination with application and bioinformatics teams. Perform routine administration of Linux servers (RHEL, Rocky Linux, or comparable), including package and patch management, service administration, and troubleshooting. Automate recurring administrative tasks using PowerShell, including the Microsoft Graph, Exchange Online, and Active Directory modules. Apply AI-assisted tools such as Microsoft Copilot to accelerate scripting, troubleshooting, and documentation, validating all generated output before it is applied to production systems and ensuring protected health information is never exposed to unapproved services. Create and maintain documentation for all implemented computer systems and update for each system change. Follow formal change management for production changes, including testing, approval, implementation, validation, and rollback planning. Racking and cabling of new systems. Participate in on-call duties and resolve escalated incidents and service requests through the IT ticketing system. Handle systems and data containing protected health information in accordance with HIPAA and applicable CLIA and CAP requirements Qualifications Knowledge/Experience Associate’s degree in a technology related field of studies, or equivalent practical experience; Bachelor’s degree preferred. 3–5+ years of hands-on systems administration experience in an enterprise environment. Demonstrated depth in Windows Server administration (2016 or later), including Active Directory Domain Services, Group Policy, DNS, and DHCP. Production experience with Microsoft Entra ID (formerly Azure AD) and hybrid identity, including Entra Connect and conditional access. Production experience administering Microsoft 365, including Exchange Online, SharePoint Online, OneDrive, and Microsoft Teams. Hands-on experience with Microsoft Intune and/or Microsoft Configuration Manager (SCCM) for Windows endpoint management. Proficiency in PowerShell for day-to-day administration and automation. Demonstrated proficiency using AI-assisted tools, such as Microsoft Copilot or comparable assistants, in a professional IT context, with the judgment to validate generated output and protect sensitive and regulated data. Experience with Hyper-V or other hypervisors. Working knowledge of enterprise backup, restore, and disaster recovery practices. Working knowledge of Linux server administration (RHEL, Rocky Linux, or comparable). Basic knowledge of AWS and Azure. Experience with systems monitoring and device management platforms. Microsoft certification such as AZ-104, MS-102, or MD-102 is a plus. Experience in a HIPAA-regulated, CLIA-certified, or CAP-accredited environment is a plus. Experience supporting multiple Active Directory forests, business entities, or Microsoft 365 tenants is a plus. Experience administering Microsoft 365 Copilot, including licensing, rollout, and associated data governance controls, is a plus. Scripting experience in Bash or Python is a plus. Strong background, knowledge, and working experience across a wide range of IT technologies, security architecture, and system life-cycle phases preferred. Strong organizational skills and ability to multi-task in a business environment. Ability to work in a fast-paced environment and demonstrates flexibility to accommodate changing priorities. Willingness to work evenings and weekends as needed to provide escalated support, and to participate in a scheduled on-call rotation. Ability to work onsite in Coppell, Texas on a hybrid schedule, currently three days per week and subject to change. Drive for Results (Service, Quality, and Continuous Improvement) – Ensure procedures and processes are in place that lead to delivery of quality results and continually reassess their effectiveness to achieve continuous improvement.
